entries.english:
The Safari Game is an opportunity
for you to capture as many Pokémon<0xFA>as you can.<0xFB>To start off, you're given special
Safari Balls.<0xFB>While playing, the Pokémon you are
attempting to capture will appear<0xFA>in front of you.<0xFB>Try your best to aim and hit it
with a Safari Ball.<0xFB>If you manage to land a hit, and
the Pokémon stays in the Safari<0xFA>Ball, it's yours to keep!<0xFB>Once you run out of Safari Balls or
choose to quit, the game is over.

O Jogo Safari é uma chance de

o jogo acaba.
